newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion sells unit, expects gain.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion sells unit, expects gain.

text.p: United Dominion Industries Ltd said Thursday it sold Bredel Holdings BV to Spirax-Sarco Engineering Plc, adding it expects to record a gain in fourth quarter results next month.
United Dominion said in a release that the transaction, including certain related assets used in the U.S. distribution of Bredel pumps, is valued at $29.7 million.

The company said the value of the sale of Bredel Holdings, a maker of peristaltic pumps based in the Netherlands, to Spirax-Sarco Engineering is subject to a reduction of up to $1.5 million depending upon 1996 results and the level of net assets at completion.
